messages:
micah: Heads-up: planning an engine runtime upgrade (engine v2.3.1) to canary-3 tonight 21:30 UTC. Quant profile = `q8-fast` (8-bit). Need smoke owners + rollback readiness. ETA ~15m for initial canary. Who can own smoke?
anya: I can take smoke for canary-3. Will run perf + correctness checks and post artifacts.
samir: I'll watch the rollout and stand by to revert if errors spike. Ping me at start.
talia: I'll tail logs and grep for OOMs / OOM-kill churn. Which metrics are our early signals?
micah: Early signals: p50/p95 latency, reject rate, and runtime metric `kv_cache_miss`. Thresholds: p95 +30% or errors >1% => rollback. Also watch memory RSS.
samir: Do we have a short rollback playbook link?
micah: Yes: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/runtime-rollback. TL;DR: 1) set weight 0 on canary-3; 2) trigger model fallback; 3) run `infra/deploy/rollback-engine --slot canary-3 --version v2.3.0`.
deploy-bot: deploy queued by @micah: engine:v2.3.1 -> canary-3 scheduled for 2024-11-20T21:30:00Z.
talia: I'll paste the smoke checklist right after deploy (quick sanity + tail logs + eval run).
anya: Running eval set `smoke/runtime/basic_prompt` and will write results to `/tmp/canary-smoke-1743005678.log`.
micah: Note: disable client-side continuous batching for canary for first 10m so we isolate perf: add `--batching=off` to client config.
eva: Can someone confirm quant artifacts uploaded to `s3://redwood-artifacts/quant/q8-fast/2.3.1`? I can verify checksums before start.
samir: Confirmed earlier — artifacts present and checksums match. If we see tokenization mismatches we can revert quant profile only.
anya: Smoke update (5m in): perf looks stable, p95 +5%, no errors, `kv_cache_miss` stable. Uploading partial logs. :thumbsup:
micah: Good. If stable at +15m we'll bump to 5% traffic and run longer baseline.
deploy-bot: deploy started by @micah at 2024-11-20T21:30:05Z. canary-3 -> engine:v2.3.1. start_ts=1743005678
samir: Monitoring dashboards now (latency, errors, pod restarts). If error rate >1% I'll execute rollback playbook.
talia: saw one OOM in pod `runtime-canary-3-a` at ~21:32, pod restarted automatically, no systemic error spike. continuing to watch.
anya: Smoke complete: PASS. Artifacts uploaded to `s3://redwood-smoke/canary-1743005678/summary.json`.
liam: I'll schedule the ramp notes in the deployment doc and flag for a broader rollout in the morning window if no regressions.
micah: Thanks all. I'll open a short follow-up thread for the traffic ramp schedule. Appreciate the quick coverage.
